description: Answer key for the 20 synthetic notebook pages. Written by hand; chemistry numbers are internally consistent except on the three pages with expect_check_issue, where one row was made wrong on purpose.

pages.title: Aspirin from salicylic acid
pages.narrative: Warmed salicylic acid with acetic anhydride and a few drops of phosphoric acid at 75 C for 15 min. Poured into ice water and filtered the white crystals. Yield 82 percent.
pages.notes: mp 134-136 C. Recrystallise from ethanol next time.

pages.title: Fischer esterification of benzoic acid
pages.narrative: Refluxed benzoic acid in dry methanol with sulfuric acid for 4 h. Quenched with sodium bicarbonate and extracted with ether. Clear oil, yield 91 percent.
pages.notes: TLC hexane/EtOAc 9:1, Rf 0.55.

pages.title: Suzuki coupling to 4-methylbiphenyl
pages.narrative: Degassed the toluene/water mix for 20 min. Heated at 85 C overnight under nitrogen. Column on silica gave white solid, yield 76 percent.
pages.notes: Catalyst was bright yellow, stored in the glovebox.

pages.title: Vanillin reduction with NaBH4
pages.narrative: Dissolved vanillin in ethanol at 0 C and added sodium borohydride in portions. Stirred 1 h at room temperature. Acidified, extracted, evaporated. Yield 88 percent.
pages.notes: Vanillyl alcohol, white needles.

pages.title: Amide coupling of benzoic acid and benzylamine
pages.narrative: Added EDC and HOBt to the acid in DMF at 0 C, then the amine and base. Stirred 16 h. Washed with dilute HCl and brine. Yield 79 percent.
pages.notes: Recheck the EDC weighing, scale looked off.

pages.title: Williamson ether synthesis
pages.narrative: Stirred 4-methoxyphenol with potassium carbonate in acetone for 30 min, added ethyl bromide and refluxed 6 h. Filtered salts, evaporated. Pale oil, yield 85 percent.
pages.notes: Ethyl bromide is volatile, kept cold.

pages.title: Aldol condensation to dibenzalacetone
pages.narrative: Mixed benzaldehyde and acetone in ethanol, added aqueous NaOH dropwise. Yellow solid appeared within 10 min. Stirred 30 min, filtered and washed with cold water. Yield 94 percent.
pages.notes: mp 110 C.

pages.title: Acetylation of aniline
pages.narrative: Dissolved aniline in water with HCl, added acetic anhydride then sodium acetate solution. White crystals formed at once. Cooled in ice and filtered. Yield 90 percent.
pages.notes: Acetanilide, mp 114 C.

pages.title: Nitration of methyl benzoate
pages.narrative: Added the nitrating mixture dropwise below 10 C. Stirred 15 min, poured onto ice. Filtered the pale solid and recrystallised from methanol. Yield 71 percent.
pages.notes: Keep below 15 C or the dinitro product forms.

pages.title: Wittig reaction to stilbene
pages.narrative: Made the ylide with potassium tert-butoxide in THF, orange colour. Added benzaldehyde and stirred 3 h. Quenched with water, column. E/Z mixture, yield 67 percent.
pages.notes: NMR shows about 1:3 E to Z.

pages.title: Copper click reaction
pages.narrative: Benzyl azide and phenylacetylene in tBuOH/water. Added copper sulfate and sodium ascorbate, stirred 12 h at room temperature. Filtered the white solid. Yield 93 percent.
pages.notes: Ascorbate mass looks wrong, redo the arithmetic.

pages.title: Boc protection of glycine methyl ester
pages.narrative: Suspended the amine salt in DCM, added triethylamine then Boc anhydride at 0 C. Warmed to room temperature overnight. Washed with citric acid. Yield 96 percent.
pages.notes: Colourless oil, solidifies in the freezer.

pages.title: Oxidation of benzyl alcohol
pages.narrative: Stirred benzyl alcohol with TEMPO and the iodine reagent in DCM for 2 h. Quenched with thiosulfate. Aldehyde smell, clean by TLC. Yield 84 percent.
pages.notes: Used it straight away, it oxidises in air.

pages.title: Friedel-Crafts acylation of anisole
pages.narrative: Cooled AlCl3 in DCM, added acetyl chloride, then anisole slowly. Stirred 1 h at 0 C. Poured on ice and HCl. Mostly para product, yield 80 percent.
pages.notes: Dry glassware, AlCl3 fumes in air.

pages.title: Saponification of methyl salicylate
pages.narrative: Refluxed methyl salicylate with aqueous NaOH for 45 min. Cooled and acidified to pH 2. White precipitate of salicylic acid, filtered and dried. Yield 89 percent.
pages.notes: Smells of wintergreen until the end.

pages.title: Reductive amination of cyclohexanone
pages.narrative: Mixed ketone and amine in DCE with a drop of acetic acid, stirred 30 min, then added the borohydride. 18 h at room temperature. Basic workup, yield 74 percent.
pages.notes: Product is a pale yellow oil.

pages.title: Sandmeyer bromination
pages.narrative: Diazotised the aniline with sodium nitrite at 0 C, added to hot copper bromide solution. Gas evolved. Steam distilled the product. Yield 58 percent.
pages.notes: Low yield, check the copper bromide amount.

pages.title: Diels-Alder of anthracene
pages.narrative: Refluxed anthracene and maleic anhydride in xylene for 30 min. Cooled and filtered the crystals. Washed with cold ether. Yield 87 percent.
pages.notes: mp 262 C.

pages.title: Steglich esterification
pages.narrative: Dissolved the acid, ethanol and DMAP in DCM, cooled to 0 C and added DCC. Stirred 12 h. Filtered off the urea. Column, yield 81 percent.
pages.notes: Urea byproduct is a pain to remove.

pages.title: Bromination of acetanilide
pages.narrative: Dissolved acetanilide in acetonitrile, added NBS in portions and stirred 4 h in the dark. Poured into water, filtered. Mostly the para isomer, yield 86 percent.
pages.notes: Wrap the flask in foil.
